page.description: What plugins add to Crew on each of your computers, and the tools they give your agents.
page.remove_body: It stops everywhere in Crew at once. Its folder goes to the plugins folder's removed items, in case you want it back.
page.install_dialog_body: Paste a link to a .zeron-plugin file, a GitHub release or a repository, or choose a file. Crew checks who signed it, and you allow what it asks before it runs.
page.offline_body: The ones you've allowed come back when Crew is running again.
page.device_offline_body: Its plugins show here once it's online again, with Crew running.
page.remove_body_device: It stops everywhere in Crew on {device} at once. Its folder goes to the removed items in that computer's plugins folder, in case you want it back.
page.install_dialog_body_device: Paste a link to a .zeron-plugin file, a GitHub release or a repository, or choose a file on this computer. Crew checks who signed it, and you allow what it asks before it runs there.

consent.unknown_why: Crew can't tell who made it. Allow it only if you trust where it came from.
consent.unverified_why: Crew can't confirm who made this. Allow it only if you trust where it came from.
consent.unverified_why_from: Crew can't confirm who made this. Allow it only if you trust where it came from: {where}.
consent.mine_confirm: Sign {name} as your own? Only if you wrote it yourself: Crew will treat it as yours from now on, on this computer.

screen_recording.description: Lets {name} capture the window in front. macOS may ask you to reopen Crew once.

init.failed_body: Crew keeps working without it until it's updated or fixed.

failure.bad_file: It has a file Crew won't write.
failure.rate_limited: GitHub is turning away requests from this device for now. Try again later, or sign in with GitHub's command-line tool (gh auth login) so Crew asks as you.
failure.no_package: That release has no file Crew can install.

page.description: Whole interfaces for Crew. Anything a template leaves out comes from the default interface.

about.out_of_date: Made for Crew {version}. Crew has updated since.
about.out_of_date_unversioned: Made for an earlier Crew. Crew has updated since.

page.delete_body: It's set aside in the templates folder, so you can get it back. If it's in use, Crew switches to the default interface.
page.install_dialog_body: Paste a link to a .zeron-template file, a GitHub release or a repository, or choose a file. Crew checks who signed it, and you allow it before it's used.

consent.keep_body: An agent made, changed or switched to this template, or it hasn't been kept since it changed. Until you keep it, it's a preview. Kept, it runs with everything Crew can do.
consent.keep_files_detail: If they change again, Crew asks again.
consent.trust_body: A template runs as part of Crew: it replaces Crew's interface and can do anything Crew can, with your chats, files, accounts and agents.
consent.unknown_body: Crew can't tell whose key signed it. Install it only if you trust where it came from.
consent.files_made_for: {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · made for Crew {version}
consent.left_out_detail: Templates can't replace these, so Crew keeps its versions: {files}
consent.unverified_body: Crew can't confirm who made this. Install it only if you trust where it came from.
consent.unverified_body_from: Crew can't confirm who made this. Install it only if you trust where it came from: {where}.
